text: The cough has been going on for about six weeks now, and it's gotten worse lately, especially when I try to walk or climb stairs. speaker: Doctor
text: Since you are declining further testing, I must rely on your history. Have you recently traveled abroad, been around anyone with a similar illness, or do you have a history of asthma or heart disease? Also, does the breathing difficulty improve when you sit up or lean forward?

speaker: Patient
text: I haven't traveled recently or been around anyone sick, and I don't have a history of asthma or heart disease beyond my hypertension and high cholesterol.
